I first thought of choosing my own project first, so I went in the internet to search for a project idea to inspire me. ### 2026-10-07 – October 7th: MAJOR BREAKTHROUGH

**2.5h**

October 7th: MAJOR BREAKTHROUGH

Today, I was very optimistic work after the long PSAT.  I don't think I mentioned it in my idea reel and my initial post, but I wanted to change the shape of starbie and make it my own. My first idea was an animal like a dog, but that didn't feel like me. So, I chose it to be a slime. A slime from the 2D platformer games we all played. Apparently, KiCAD doesn't have spline to trace over my reference photo. So, I opened up fusion.

![Screenshot 2026-10-07 220825](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/596d395875c58f8a72728adcd660aeb793b22eec58708913162a92d165ec1998.png)
(bruh, im not waiting for this...)

So I opened my trusty browser Onshape and got started. But when I was done with it, I didn't like it. It felt simple and boring. Then this came.

![Screenshot 2026-10-07 221343](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/5b65647027eff8106f2c427e99f0a7faf6fdcb4a42344f4e5ba2374f5d42cd5c.png)

DITTO!!!!! What an amazing underappreciated Pokemon. Took some time with the splines and made it perfect to my abilities. Then, I imported this to my KiCAD and set it as the boundary.

![Screenshot 2026-10-07 224033](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/7115e8e57a541fc46195547bd24068f0746231d7d0b4c8abb2343f0ca7d5a079.png)

I wanted to feel like I was interacting with ditto so I put both the keycaps on its "hand". Also, I wanted the eyes and mouth to be filled in, and apparently I could use Silkscreen, so I did that. Hopefully that isn't the issue.

I have no clue how this took 2.5 hours so not my most productive day. But, now I feel like I'm doing my own project!!!

### 2026-10-08 – October 8th: PCB DONE!

**1.5h**

October 8th: PCB DONE!

Started my session by creating the 5 hour progress reel. I realized I haven't made much progress with the amount of time I am spending. Good news, I finished the wiring even though it took so long trying to make all the wires connected without overlapping.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/5131ab20750ce6eb2585cdb387c8eaead0857f9b535f7a232705113a0ca35943.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/b683c8a138f3033edcd8bc660139e0de7d7700c388feaca7625d68ac3c0afb55.png)

I loved it and tried my best to add them individually to the pcb. However, I just could not figure it out so maybe I will get back to that after I finish the firmware.

### 2026-10-10 – October 10th: Ditto Animations!!!

**3h**

October 10th: Ditto Animations!!!

Today I wanted to work on all the animations that I wanted for Ditto so that the user can really feel like they are interacting with Ditto. Yesterday I made 32x32 pixel art for Ditto but realized it was too small on the OLED display so I created another custom 48x48 pixel art with idle animation. (2 Frame)

![download 3](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/958fea2a636e9e8c3db6afd884b52ab84039f6f1417312c95aab70964ce38a69.png)

![download 4](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/657b3447e75b1e0a324a93772a8f1c1636e2843eed3561479c25c89fea871d0e.png)

Then I was working on flipping the animation/frame when Ditto bounces from a wall. This coding took a lot longer than I expected because it was hard implementing the method that reverses the Ditto bitmap. I also added three sparkles that could be activated by changing a boolean that spawns randomly around and on top of Ditto to show like the "shiny Pokemon" effect.

Now I wanted to add two animation for Ditto which was Sleeping and Eating. After a bit of inspiration from Pinterest I made these.

![download 5](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/146cdbaf28e4a19c0e5816bca780052eef730b521b17380b65692ec2631c05ba.png)

![download 6](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/4de6cd01739e8adeb3178b4394190e9e56237efbbcca87a7d9ab98512834f73d.png)

The sleeping animation is so cute and I went really basic with the eating animation.
